headline: Local, amateur filmmakers share space with established directors at the Pinnacles Film Festival.
summary: The inaugural Pinnacles Film Festival in King City offers a chance for local, independent filmmakers to showcase their work. The concept has resonated; there are 37 films in the lineup, presented in three theaters over a single day, Oct. 10.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
